title: A spilling formula written without its range shows one value in Google Sheets
symptom: a dynamic array formula written to spill from its cell alone (Python `set_formula(..., spill=True)` or `Formula(..., spill=True)`, Rust `Spill::Anchor`, CLI `set --formula --spill`, edit map `"spill": true`) is stored on that cell (`<f t="array" ref="J2">`, as XlsxWriter stores it): Excel spills it over its result when it opens the workbook, but Google Sheets takes the extent from `ref` and shows the first value alone. The extent is the size of the formula's result, which only an evaluator knows; the evaluator of the second set of #365 will write it
workaround: give the range the result fills, from the formula's cell, its other cells empty: `spill="J2:J5"` in Python, `Spill::Range` in Rust, `--spill J2:J5` or `"spill": "J2:J5"` in the CLI; Google Sheets then spills it over that range, as Excel does
